title: Prove sharp ten-call minimum for four mixed affine targets (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof: Cinna Davis's PR #1745 target `diag(h,h^-1,tx,ty)` needs exactly ten paid calls over formal `F2[AGL_2(F2)]`, even with free scalar mixing and any finite number of restored dirty spectators.

```diff
- Four fixed labels {a,b,tx,ty}: minimum in [8,10]
+ Exactly 10: at least 6 a/b calls and at least 4 tx/ty calls
```

The translation-forgetting quotient leaves two swaps. A six-address regular cut gives the six-call charge. The homogeneous translation block has rank four, giving the separate four-call charge. The letter classes are disjoint, so the bounds add. The existing direct word attains ten. This closes the predecessor's eight/nine-call question with a written proof; its old searches are not replayed or claimed as new.

This contribution is produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 for #1745's target, alphabet, open interval and direct word; Gareth Davidson / bitplane for #1333's affine framework; commdata2338 for #1414's two-swap minimum; Adam Gall for #1941's related cut method; and eumemic, Ali Romman, David Govea and the retained register-model lineage. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before, #1745 left eight and nine calls unresolved. After, `PROOF.md` proves a uniform ten-call lower bound and the new standard-library verifier checks its exact finite representations and full formal endpoints.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- All 576 quotient products and all 651 binary rank-one idempotents through five roles, with each of the four paid labels.
- Both endpoint bounds through eight roles; 146 small matrices checked against independent row-span enumeration.
- Nine complete formal witnesses and 1,344 faithful regular-action original input columns, including scalar mixing involving arbitrary dirty spectators. All 90 omitted-paid-call controls reject.
- Invalid couplings/labels, wrong target order, dirty leakage, representation aliases and an enlarged-alphabet control.
- Warning-strict direct normal and optimized checks took 0.117 and 0.119 seconds locally. These are whole-check durations, not a performance improvement claim. Both registered commands pass, each below its 120-second timeout.
- Metadata/source pins and committed-byte/source-history preflight pass for all six package files at `c4484f0242a3f85b6c822bcb2e0b7c1646496e01`.

Each run emits a generated receipt bound to all package source hashes. Nothing is handwritten as a receipt. Normal replay writes no files and imports no predecessor executable or scientific receipt.

From the worktree root:

```sh

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/affine-four-target-sharp-ten/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/affine-four-target-sharp-ten --check-source-history
```

Use another CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. Expected markers include `PASS_AFFINE_FOUR_TARGET_SHARP_TEN minimum=10 linear_floor=6 translation_floor=4`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

The advance [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19217827) proposed a finite search. A direct proof settled the stated target first, so no solver search was needed. Canonical main remains `de5ec2e7a6074068452f45b1a191b5c72832df4a`, priority revision 8. The connector card's changed scope and overlap limits are recorded in TASK.json.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a scoped written proof with finite corroboration, not a formal proof-kernel result or a complete multiplication theorem. It requires the four fixed labels, rank-one idempotent couplings, binary scalar mixing and a complete arbitrary-dirty endpoint. Larger alphabets, clean-only outputs, erasure, nonlinear/adaptive programs and nonfaithful specialized address actions are outside the claim.

No physical native operation, scalar/frame/owner/hosting contract, movement/precision/stock/tape bill, productive credit or complete recursive invoice is supplied. Those costs are unknown. The selected cold replay, Lean, Docker and predecessor scientific suites were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

Can a concrete native implementation justify one additional affine label that escapes the separated charge? Start with one explicit label and price its complete entrance/exit, scalar, frame, restoration and recursive bill. An h label changes the representation charge, but its native cost is unknown. No larger search within the unchanged four-label model can beat ten.

## Related open work

- #5879 studies the larger binary-affine paid alphabet with clean allocation and erasure. This PR fixes only `{a,b,tx,ty}` and a complete restored-dirty endpoint; its ten-call minimum is for that different contract. No common optimum is asserted.
- #5877 studies two anticommuting query types over characteristic different from two. Its query shear and ordinary coefficient algebra differ from this characteristic-two affine register endpoint; no shared numerical tariff is compared.

The live affine search found no other open PR studying this exact four-target tariff. The completion refresh lists no still-open PR from this account created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-10-27T13:29:18Z, so there is no additional related open contribution to add. No additional mathematical computation was run to check another contribution.

No new commits were pushed after the archive merge.
